questions.de: Nach welchem venezianischen Renaissancemaler ist ein goldroter Farbton benannt?
questions.en: Which Venetian Renaissance painter is a golden-red colour shade named after?

timeline.labelEn: Life of Titian, leading painter of the Venetian Renaissance
timeline.labelDe: Leben Tizians, des führenden Malers der venezianischen Renaissance

questions.notes: Reworked from a multiple-choice question. The shade is Tizianrot (Titian red), which he liked to use for women's hair. Titian's birth year is uncertain (about 1488/90); he died on 27 August 1576.

questions.cardDe: Russlands Landesfläche ist größer als die Oberfläche des Zwergplaneten Pluto. Richtig oder falsch?
questions.de: Welches Land hat mit rund 17 Millionen km² eine Landesfläche fast so groß wie die gesamte Oberfläche des Zwergplaneten Pluto?
questions.en: Which country, at about 17 million km², has a land area almost as large as the entire surface of the dwarf planet Pluto?

timeline.labelEn: Clyde Tombaugh discovers Pluto at Lowell Observatory
timeline.labelDe: Clyde Tombaugh entdeckt Pluto am Lowell-Observatorium

questions.notes: The card's claim is outdated: with the radius measured by New Horizons (1188.3 km), Pluto's surface is about 17.7 million km², slightly larger than Russia's 17.1 million km² (de.wikipedia: Russland). With older, smaller radius estimates Russia came out larger. Hence reworked into an open question that holds either way.

questions.cardDe: Welcher Physiker segelte zwar 50 Jahre lang, lief dabei aber auch mal auf Grund, verlor die Orientierung auf See und hatte viele Fast-Zusammenstöße?
questions.de: Welcher Physiker segelte zwar 50 Jahre lang, lief dabei aber auch mal auf Grund, verlor die Orientierung auf See und hatte viele Fast-Zusammenstöße?
questions.en: Which physicist sailed for 50 years, yet sometimes ran aground, lost his bearings at sea and had many near collisions?

timeline.labelEn: Life of Albert Einstein, physicist and keen amateur sailor
timeline.labelDe: Leben Albert Einsteins, Physiker und leidenschaftlicher Hobbysegler

questions.notes: Einstein sailed from about age 20 until his death; in 1935 he ran aground on a sand bar in the Connecticut River, and in 1944 he capsized on Saranac Lake although he could not swim.
